title: Audit and execute the first owned-title allocation checkpoint
goal: Bind and validate the first actual SP/MP NtAllocateVirtualMemory call through the verified memory-imports-v1 kernel, then stop and tear down before resuming further unreviewed title execution; preserve the historical header-only checkpoint.
acceptance: Before admission, bind both exact owned executable hashes, metadata/generation/compiler/SDK identities, import name/ordinal/thunk and caller return address; independently inspect original PPC argument setup and a bounded read-only pre-call capture, keeping translated code and traces private

Add an explicit allocation checkpoint requiring the verified repaired SDK, exact per-role call-site/argument contract and one-call/size budgets; validate complete readable/writable in/out words and neighbouring snapshots before invoking the original actual kernel export, without success stubs or generated guest-source edits

Independently check actual status, endian output geometry, relevant committed edge/state and unchanged neighbouring bytes against the audited selected-fork contract; stop before returning to translated code after the admitted call, with all other imports guarded and no claim about subsequent startup or unreviewed data variables

Verify owned thread stop metadata, handle/thread/runtime recovery, unload and mapping release on Windows/Linux and supported host/participating-kernel sanitizer profiles; preserve explicitly selected header-only behavior and its negative/interrupt regressions

Reject changed build/call-site/receipt/package/source/config/binding/pointer/result identities and incomplete/late evidence; retain real negative controls, exact loaded-module/log/binary identities and a source-only report without marking first-frame, gameplay or retail ABI parity complete
validation: Run repeated isolated SP/MP first-call checkpoints and meaningful binding/pointer/oracle/incomplete/deadline controls on native Windows/Linux and supported host/core profiles, with no simultaneous GPU-heavy suite and at most two build workers

Run the existing bounded header-only title regressions plus public synthetic protocol/configuration/mutation/output-isolation guards and python tools/check.py with relevant supported platform/sanitizer checks

Record exact commands, matched baseline and revised source/compiler/config/SDK/generation/binary/log hashes, resource budgets, skips, retained failures, provenance and self-review; stop and split any new SDK or guest-service defect rather than widening admission
size: bounded first actual allocation call plus immediate diagnostic teardown; later title startup and rendering remain separate
